requirements.summary: Add Google AdSense script tag to HTML head section with async loading and crossorigin attribute
acceptanceCriteria: The AdSense script is present in frontend/index.html within the <head> section
The script includes the async attribute
The script src URL matches exactly: https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-4905807488237044
The crossorigin attribute is set to 'anonymous'
The script loads without errors in browser console

file_operations.description: Insert Google AdSense script tag in the <head> section before the closing </head> tag. The script must include: async attribute for non-blocking load, exact src URL 'https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-4905807488237044', and crossorigin='anonymous' attribute. Place the script after existing meta tags but before the module script reference to main.tsx to ensure AdSense loads early in the page lifecycle.
